sources.title: Arnold Kreuter
sources.supports: Member profile at Kunstverein postWERK: born 1950 in Villach, lives and works there; painting since 1976; seminars with Franz Schneeweiß, August Svoboda and others; Kultur-Ehrenzeichen of the City of Villach 2018 and 2021
sources.note: Member profile (WordPress post first dated 2014-04-04, content updated since); date left null because it is a profile, not an article.

sources.title: über mich
sources.supports: Born 2 December 1981 in Worms; Krumpendorf am Wörthersee since 2016; Waldorf education with focus on art at the Freie Hochschule Stuttgart; four-year course at the Akademie der Bildenden Künste Kärnten from 2020; portrait and nude studies, process-based painting in mixed media; teaching visual art in Italy and Austria

sources.title: Eva Asaad
sources.supports: City of Klagenfurt artist profile: photo artist and curator, born 1970 in Klagenfurt, diploma in media communication and education (University of Klagenfurt), Prague School of Photography, initiator of the photo competition 'Wort im Bild'
sources.note: The page does not state the 2011 start of 'Wort im Bild', the 2025 Alpen-Adria-Galerie show, 'cultural adviser' or BV Kärnten membership. Related pages that hold those facts (not klagenfurt.at): stadtgalerie.net Alpen-Adria-Galerie archive 2025 (https://www.stadtgalerie.net/alpen-adria-galerie/ausstellungsarchiv/ausstellungsarchiv-2025, 'META - MORPH 10.1', 5 Feb – 23 Mar 2025, photo works on antique sculptures) and the biography PDF there (BV membership; gives 2012 for 'Wort im Bild').

sources.title: Curriculum Vitae
sources.supports: Born 1962 in Klagenfurt; philosophy and German studies at the University of Klagenfurt, master's in philosophy 1986; painting at the Freie Akademie der Bildenden Künste und Literatur Kärnten, diploma 2009; Carinthian Art Award 1st prize 2009; member of BV Kärnten; freelance, lives in Klagenfurt
sources.note: Her role as auditor (Rechnungsprüferin) of BV Kärnten is not on this page.

sources.title: Trigeniale Brda im Herbst
sources.supports: Opening report of 'Trigeniale Brda 26' at Kmetija Moro (Goriška Brda), autumn 2026: Giulia Cernetig from Udine with Aleksandra Rusjan and Margrit Pernull; Cernetig of the Gruppo artistico culturale Albrecht Dürer from Tavagnacco (UD); cooperation with bewegungINkultur
sources.note: The announcement of 18 September 2026 holds the same facts: https://www.meinbezirk.at/klagenfurt/c-regionauten-community/neue-dreilaenderausstellung-trigeniale-brda-26-in-gorika-brda_a8905011

sources.title: 'The Breath of Color' | Exhibition
sources.supports: Solo exhibition 'The Breath of Color' by Giulia Cernetig, 6–27 June 2026, hosted by the Municipality of San Pietro al Natisone/Špeter in its council chamber
sources.note: Event-calendar entry (no publication date).

sources.title: Biographie
sources.supports: Born 4 December 1959 in Klagenfurt, grew up in Völkermarkt; painting since 1973/74; medicine in Vienna and Graz 1979–1984; since grandfather Werner Berg's death in 1981 manager of the estate and curator of the Werner Berg Museum Bleiburg/Pliberk; general practice in Völkermarkt from 1987, handed over 2025
sources.note: Painting outdoors in front of the subject (south-eastern Carinthia) is on the 'Über mich' page: https://scheicher.cc/ueber-mich

sources.title: Sigrid Friedmann
sources.supports: Born 4 May 1978 in Klagenfurt; school in Bad Bleiberg; HBLA für Kunstgewerbe Linz; Meisterschule für Bildhauerei Graz; visual media design under Bernhard Leitner and Erwin Wurm at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, diploma with distinction 2006; 2017 Förderungspreis für Film, Fotografie, elektronische Medien des Landes Kärnten; association sogx.net with Ulrich Kaufmann
sources.note: The site has no working HTTPS (https://www.sogx.net fails); only the http URL loads (200). The page title is just 'sogx'; the headline on the page is 'SIGRID FRIEDMANN'.

sources.title: HELMUT DITSCH
sources.supports: Born 1962 in Buenos Aires; 1988 to Austria, the country of his ancestors, to study at the Academy of Fine Arts Vienna; commission from the Oesterreichische Nationalbank 1997; large-format nature paintings; professor at UNSAM 2015
sources.note: One-page site: the biography is on the homepage itself (section 'about').

sources.title: Boris Podrecca
sources.supports: Austrian Sculpture Park artist page: born 1940 in Belgrade; Academy of Fine Arts Vienna, Roland Rainer's master class 1963–1968; squares, railway stations, offices, dwellings; Universitätsplatz Salzburg, Piazza Tartini Piran; Trieste, where he spent part of his youth
sources.note: German version: https://www.museum-joanneum.at/skulpturenpark/entdecken/kuenstlerinnen/podrecca-boris

sources.title: PODRECCA ARCHITECTS: Studio
sources.supports: Office PODRECCA ARCHITECTS founded in Vienna in 1986; built in eight European countries and in China

sources.title: Künstler T26-1+2 – artist sheets of the exhibition Trigeniale 26
sources.supports: Born in Nuremberg, lives in Tavagnacco since childhood; singer and vice president of the Coro Bariglarie; vice president of the Gruppo artistico culturale Albrecht Dürer; exhibition organising, ceramics/raku, paintings with flotsam, exhibitions
sources.note: Word-made PDF by Gerhard Lepicnik (organiser), dated 13 October 2026, with the artist sheet of Alessandra Minin; local copy at _360_GALLERIES_AND_TOURS/collection/_galleries/studiogalerie_klagenfurt/2026-10-15-studiogalerie-klagenfurt-trigeniale-26/_Material/Künstler T26-1+2 - deutsch.pdf. No online copy found: the meinbezirk.at article on Trigeniale 26 (https://www.meinbezirk.at/klagenfurt/c-regionauten-community/trigeniale-26-alpenadriatische-harmonie-im-stadthaus-klagenfurt_a8961771, 2026-10-18) does not reproduce these biographies.

sources.title: Angerer-Guggenberger, Marjeta
sources.supports: GND authority record of the German National Library: textile artist (Textilkünstlerin), born 1963, place of birth Ljubljana, place of activity Vienna
sources.note: Persistent GND URI; it redirects (HTTP 200) to the record in the DNB catalogue (portal.dnb.de), which shows a bot check to scripts. Record content verified through lobid.org (https://lobid.org/gnd/1168912911).

sources.title: FRAGIL | Jahresthema 2026
sources.supports: Guest artist of 'FRAGIL' at the Dinzlschloss Villach; vernissage 8 September 2026 with the performative reading 'Häutungen' by Karin Prucha and Marjeta Angerer-Guggenberger

sources.title: Über den Künstler
sources.supports: Manager of a Carinthian energy company who drew and painted; courses with Wilfried Steurer (caricature) and Ulrike Reinwald (nude, portrait), Kunstforum 'Zeitlos' of Herbert Schwei; white chalk on black paper; exhibitions at the Pädagogisches Institut Klagenfurt, Cologne, Europahaus Klagenfurt (EU founding fathers), Galerie Kreativraum Vienna ('Liebe auf den ersten Blick'), Friuli, Slovenia; pastel still lifes, insects, flowers
sources.note: The page loads (HTTP 200) only when the browser ignores the TLS certificate: the certificate of www.nackler.com has expired (already noted on 2026-10-23 in the Trigeniale 26 sources.txt, where the link was left out for that reason). Browsers show a security warning.

sources.title: Künstler T26-1+2 – artist sheets of the exhibition Trigeniale 26
sources.supports: Grew up in Upper Carinthia, lives in Klagenfurt; courses with Wilfried Steurer and others; drawings in white chalk on black; exhibitions
sources.note: Word-made PDF by Gerhard Lepicnik (organiser), dated 13 October 2026, with the artist sheet of Karl Nackler; local copy at _360_GALLERIES_AND_TOURS/collection/_galleries/studiogalerie_klagenfurt/2026-10-15-studiogalerie-klagenfurt-trigeniale-26/_Material/Künstler T26-1+2 - deutsch.pdf. No online copy found: the meinbezirk.at article on Trigeniale 26 (https://www.meinbezirk.at/klagenfurt/c-regionauten-community/trigeniale-26-alpenadriatische-harmonie-im-stadthaus-klagenfurt_a8961771, 2026-10-18) does not reproduce these biographies.

sources.title: Information
sources.supports: Born 1974 in Klagenfurt; commissioned industrial, architecture, portrait, reportage, landscape photography and art documentation; clients incl. ALBERTINA and MMKK; exhibitions photo::vienna 2015 at the MAK and 'TOUCH WOOD' at MMKK and Stadtgalerie Klagenfurt 2019/2020

sources.title: BACHINGER © ARTIST EB
sources.supports: Member profile: born in Munich, lives and works in Carinthia and Vienna; business administration, advertising consultant, copywriter, creative director; freelance artist in painting, sculpture, installation, photography; exhibitions in Vienna, Villach, Venice, New York, Klagenfurt, Santa Monica, Ljubljana; member of postWERK since 2022
sources.note: Member profile (WordPress post dated 2014-04-12, content updated since); date left null.

sources.title: Atomic Hares
sources.supports: Bilingual leaflet (text Elisabeth Hochwarter): school years in Munich, studies and career in advertising, return to art in 2003; lives and works in Vienna, Carinthia and New York City
sources.note: Linked as 'More' from the page 'The Artist' (https://www.ernstbachinger.com/the-artist), whose own HTML holds only the name; the site is a JavaScript (Wix) site. Business studies, the exact job titles, the exhibition places and postWERK membership are on postwerk.at, not here.

sources.title: Atelier Herbert Boeckl
sources.supports: Chronology: born in Klagenfurt 1894, died in Vienna 20 January 1966; 1912 architecture at the Technische Hochschule and private lessons with Adolf Loos after failed Academy application; professor from 1935; NSDAP 1941; 'politisch unzuverlässig' 1944; provisional rector 1945, removed 1946 for not registering as former NSDAP member; Seckau frescoes 1951–1960; rector 1962; studio Argentinierstraße 42 from 1928
sources.note: English version: https://www.belvedere.at/en/herbert-boeckl ('Studio Herbert Boeckl').

sources.title: Vielseitige Ausstellung vom Slowenen JURE MARKOTA
sources.supports: Biography: born 1985 in Slovenj Gradec; studied sculpture at the Academy of Fine Arts and Design in Ljubljana; lives and works in Carinthia and Slovenia
sources.note: The page does not give the start year 2004 or the fields graphic design, architecture and new media; those came from a search snippet of taxos.at (host not reachable, per plans/2026-11-01__four-new-galleries/persons-research.json).

sources.title: Impuls und Synergie | Jure Markota
sources.supports: Exhibition 'Impuls und Synergie' at the Kunstbahnhof Wörthersee in Velden, vernissage 18 October 2024; sculptor living in Carinthia and Slovenia

sources.title: Elisabeth Penker
sources.supports: WIELS artist-in-residence page: born 1974; sculpture at the Academy of Fine Arts Vienna under Bruno Gironcoli; theory researcher at the Jan van Eyck Academie Maastricht; series 'Split Representation' (painted photo collages of philosophers, anthropologists, artists); sound compositions based on grammatical classifications of languages
sources.note: The page does not give the years 1993–1998, the Oslo academy, the year 2006 or the residency year 2016. Her CV at Charim Galerie holds them (1993–1998 Gironcoli; 1998 Oslo; 2006 Jan van Eyck; residency 2016 WIELS) and links this WIELS page: https://www.charimgalerie.at/items/uploads/module_pdf/CV2025ElisabethPenker.pdf

sources.title: Künstler T26-1+2 – artist sheets of the exhibition Trigeniale 26
sources.supports: Grew up in Abtei (Carinthia), lives in Klagenfurt; from fashion design to art; nude drawing with Rudolf Fuchs and Susanne Axmann; techniques and series; exhibitions in Carinthia, Friuli, Trieste, Genoa, Cologne, Vienna, Slovenia; member of Österreichischer Kunstverein and bewegungINkultur
sources.note: Word-made PDF by Gerhard Lepicnik (organiser), dated 13 October 2026, with the artist sheet of Marlis Lepicnik; local copy at _360_GALLERIES_AND_TOURS/collection/_galleries/studiogalerie_klagenfurt/2026-10-15-studiogalerie-klagenfurt-trigeniale-26/_Material/Künstler T26-1+2 - deutsch.pdf. No online copy found: the meinbezirk.at article on Trigeniale 26 (https://www.meinbezirk.at/klagenfurt/c-regionauten-community/trigeniale-26-alpenadriatische-harmonie-im-stadthaus-klagenfurt_a8961771, 2026-10-18) does not reproduce these biographies.

sources.title: BIODIVERSITÄT ENTDECKEN – Kleine Künstler*innen für eine große Vielfalt
sources.supports: Living Studio archive entry, 30 May – 6 September 2026: EU project Climate Art City; school classes, kidsmobil workshop of the wissens.wert.welt at the kärnten.museum; animal rescue islands; three classes awarded (hedgehog, wolf, lynx); proceeds to Climate Fund Klagenfurt; scientific supervision and project lead names; partners
sources.note: Section on the page 'Ausstellungsarchiv 2026' of the Living Studio (no separate page per exhibition). The list of the participating schools is a PDF linked there: https://www.stadtgalerie.net/fileadmin/user_upload/Stadtgalerie_Klagenfurt/Living_Studio/Ausstellungsarchiv/2026/Biodiversitaet/Liste_teilnehmende_Schulen.pdf

sources.title: FRANZ GRABMAYR – Alles Farbe
sources.supports: Exhibition 'Alles Farbe', opening 19 November 2026, 18:00, run 20 November 2026 – 31 January 2027; painter died 2015, comes from Carinthia
sources.note: Preview page of the Stadtgalerie ('Ausstellungsvorschau'); its content changes as the programme moves on and will later move to the 2026/2027 archive page. The invitation PDF is linked from https://www.stadtgalerie.net/stadtgalerie/aktuelle-ausstellung

sources.title: KARLHEINZ SIMONITSCH
sources.supports: Living Studio preview: Karlheinz Simonitsch, opening 1 December 2026, 18:00, run 2 December 2026 – 31 January 2027, 'Änderungen vorbehalten'
sources.note: Preview page ('Ausstellungsvorschau') of the Living Studio; its content changes as the programme moves on.

sources.title: Ausstellung Klaus Zlattinger and Friends
sources.supports: Exhibition for the 10th anniversary of Klaus Zlattinger's death (December 2016); artist, art educator and gallerist; works by Wolfgang Daborer, Christine De Pauli, Otmar Eder, Karl Vouk (the page now also names Gustav Januš); reading by Christine Strobl-Oman from 'alles leben'; further works in the Marktgemeindeamt Seeboden; vernissage 13 November 2026
sources.note: Event page; the separate vernissage event is https://kultur-impuls.com/events/vernissage-klaus-zlattinger-and-friends-2/ . The page now names Gustav Januš as a fifth artist friend, which the text does not list.

sources.title: Der Verein „kultur.im.puls“
sources.supports: Association exists since 2009; art education, concerts, readings; activities incl. painting Saturdays and Artothek
sources.note: Board (Obfrau Carolin Meinl, Ehrenobmann DI Peter Kleinfercher) is on https://kultur-impuls.com/vorstand-und-team/ ; the staircase gallery on https://kultur-impuls.com/unsere-galerie/ . 'Since 2024' for the chair and the second space in the municipal office stairwell were not found on these pages.

sources.supports: Impuls Center Seeboden; owner Peter Kleinfercher (intended)
sources.note: https://www.impulscenter.at/ answers 403 Forbidden and every sub-path tried (index.html, /kontakt/, /impressum/ …) answers 404; WebFetch also gets 403; the Internet Archive was offline. No page of the site could be read, so no exact URL can be given.

sources.title: kärnten.museum
sources.supports: History from 1844 (Geschichtsverein für Kärnten); Rudolfinum, Museumgasse 2, opened 10 July 1884; water damage 2014; general renovation; reopened 21 November 2022 as kärnten.museum, formerly Landesmuseum Kärnten

sources.title: Über uns
sources.supports: wissens.wert.welt: hands-on museum (Mitmach-Museum) for children and young people in the kärnten.museum; the Kidsmobil drives across Carinthia to the schools with workshops
